import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set the color palette
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
sns.set_palette(colors)

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for i, species in enumerate(df['species'].unique()):
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=colors[i], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for i, species in enumerate(df['species'].unique()):
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=colors[i], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plots for Petal Length
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df.boxplot(column='petal_length', by='species', ax=ax3, patch_artist=True,
           boxprops=dict(facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7),
           medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2),
           whiskerprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=1.5),
           capprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=1.5))
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
plt.suptitle('')  # Remove the automatic title from boxplot

# 4. Violin plot for all measurements
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Melt the dataframe for violin plot
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', 
                    value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                    var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.violinplot(data=df_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
               ax=ax4, palette=colors, alpha=0.8, split=False)
ax4.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of All Measurements by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'], fontsize=9)
ax4.legend(title='Species', frameon=True, shadow=True, loc='upper right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
